priority.override_reason: Rank-one controlflow-recursive remains closed by the current direct-leaf frame, tail-reset, same-function frame-stack, scalar-recursion, compact-dispatch, and lazy-frame-state rejection evidence. This pre-implementation unit was rejected by source audit: Vm::call_env for a user bytecode callee attaches a host to self.env.new_function_frame(), while Vm::realm_env attaches a host to self.env.empty_frame(), and CallEnv::empty_frame is exactly a new_function_frame alias. The HashMap and A* receipts establish construction frequency, not a distinct parent-context cost. No candidate source, binary, or fast-gate run is warranted; retain this artifact so the false boundary is not retried as a constructor-body, property-layout, or call-frame mechanism.

mechanism.summary: Rejected during source audit before implementation: substituting realm_env for the user-bytecode call_env in ordinary direct-leaf construction cannot remove a parent context because both paths build the same host-attached new_function_frame. No runtime route is added; construct_function, caller refresh, constructor validation, new.target installation and restoration, prototype resolution, receiver allocation, slot-backed body execution, result selection, and every observable property operation remain unchanged.
mechanism.generality: No construction changes admission or execution. The originally proposed existing direct-leaf predicate is deliberately not emitted because its realm-only replacement is representation-identical to the generic user-bytecode CallEnv. Native, bound, Proxy, class, generator, async, direct-eval, with, closure-capturing, arguments-object, non-seedable-parameter, and every other construction remain on their existing paths.
semantic_risks: the apparent CallEnv substitution is an exact construction alias, so a branch would add dispatch cost without removing allocation or observable work

ordinary and Reflect.construct new.target identity, receiver prototype lookup, property behavior, exceptions, and caller sloppy-global refresh must remain untouched because no candidate runtime code is justified
future construction work must profile a distinct cost beneath construct_function rather than treating ObjectRef allocation counts as evidence for a parent CallEnv difference
